events.text: A catastrophic blow to Nuwo: legions of Petenogogo overrun the citadel of Dalosha, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Festival of Colours: People of Shrisva wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Dravvekot.
Festival of Colours: People of Tradesh wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Yrakot.
A catastrophic blow to Wekimu: legions of Goga overrun the citadel of Hefi, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Empire of Lahliptlan ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Hehpoma Mohwohson flees the ashes of their former dominion.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the Lahliptlan Campaign after 1 year. With frontiers redrawn, Yufoketi & Goga dictate terms to the vanquished.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Grand Marshalate of Nuwo ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Wo'nu Wi'u flees the ashes of their former dominion.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the War of the Nuwo Crown after 1 year. With frontiers redrawn, Petenogogo dictate terms to the vanquished.
Flames engulf the towers of Hewuga! Soldiers of Goga force the inner courtyards of Wekimu's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.
Festival of the Ancestors: Families in Lita set out lamps and food for their dead at Nole.
Envoys from Sawago and Goko exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Envoys from Helukenese and Qihnuq exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
With swords drawn and ancient pacts invoked, Confederation of Yufoketi marches against Syndicate of Hvimvoshra. The Hvimvoshra Campaign begins.

Ambition stirs in the courts of Syndicate of Lihapisuyu, which openly claims dominion over Grand Duchy of Vikdyirt. The clan-state braces as the Great Lihapisuyu War erupts. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Pregha rally to Vikdyirt's side.
With swords drawn and ancient pacts invoked, Workers' Federation of Goko marches against Sultanate of Dricve. The Dricve Campaign begins.
Fadshom of Pisfas takes up the cause of knowledge.
In Pisfas, Lelzhapa the Younger Kodgen departs this life, succumbing to battle wounds. The child Fadshom (age 7) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.
Yalmeshsa (Archmage) unravels a supernatural anomaly in the mountains in Goshokhzim.
Kempeyftot (Grand Champion) sets an unprecedented record in the sprint and javelin throwing trials in Kankant.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Goga! Fewepa seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Theocracy of Goga!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Bozedia stir mutiny among garrison troops in Ta'wi!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Vivvupdesa embarks upon the Rescue of the Royal Heir in Badbak! Vivvupdesa gathers scouts and infiltrates the frontier redoubts near Badbak to pinpoint the captive's cell.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Mefahuma pave the Mefahuma-Gaguhe Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Mefahuma and Gaguhe (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Lihapisuyu pave the Sawamawuhu-Mamipiwi Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Sawamawuhu and Mamipiwi (+trade, +stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Gorath the Stone Peak heaves rich subterranean veins to the surface of Lihapisuyu! Granite ramparts harden against all siegecraft (+25 gold, +15 stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Tzannik the Architect of Fate mutates the weave of fate in Grasva! Arcane mutations grant uncanny clairvoyance and secret gold, at the cost of civil panic (+30 gold, -6 stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Sylvanor the Forest Horn awakens the ancient canopies of Pregha! Verdant thickets ensnare enemies and provide abundant woodland forage (+16 stability, +10% army power).
ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Cthulor the Abyssal Slumberer stirs in the ocean abyss beneath Goko! Barnacle-encrusted cyclopean monoliths surface, loaded with pre-human treasure (+35 gold, -5 stability).
The Seekers of the Primal Strain spreads a whispering fungus through Dipe, promising one shared mind for all.
The Order of the Grafted Saint spreads a whispering fungus through Nuskich, promising one shared mind for all.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in No'cha (Ta'wi); tax riots in Seshakolalibela (Mabo).

One conquered Floor 2 (Floor of the Emerald Canopy) using assault (score 33 vs DC 8). Defeated Zephyros. Promoted to F-Rank!
Oma survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 13 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red.
Masked dancers fill Niwkenpin for the festival of the ancestors; the spirits walk among the people of Oyo-petege.
Stepwells are dug across Yvavarta; Yrigre survives the dry season with water to spare.
In the lands Lenmennesnel won by the sword, 8 districts now speak the Chanmat tongue and keep its customs.
A great fungal bloom carpets the caverns of Tsugha; spore-bread and lamp-moss for all.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Fatabad bars the shaft to Titu, and the tithe-collectors of Lihapisuyu are turned back at the lamps of Fatabad.
Lihapisuyu squeezes the shaft-tolls of Yokhtosh; the miners of Yokhtosh mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Beygakh bars the shaft to Zhazhyshahr, and the tithe-collectors of Kapgnavshahr are turned back at the lamps of Vikdyirt.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Mefahuma close the air-lanes above Hiwakeli, starving Goga of the high trade.
Garrisons of Goko storm the ramparts of Mipco, driving out the defenders of Dricve and hoisting their triumphant colors.
A catastrophic blow to Hvimvoshra: legions of Yufoketi overrun the citadel of Vrabad, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Lihapisuyu overruns the defensive holdfasts of Rewofe, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Pregha.
An ancient sovereign power falls to dust: People's Republic of Wekimu is extinguished. Royal archives smolder, and Mutifa Himehe flees into obscurity.
Yam Feast: Granaries of Pawo are opened at Fidenogo; the whole town eats until dusk.
Feast of the Ancestors: Families in Pregha set out lamps and food for their dead at Skitzi.
A victor's peace is forged: after 3 years of campaign in the Goga–Wekimu War, Goga prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the War of the Kobolalibela Crown after 4 years. With frontiers redrawn, Bozedia dictate terms to the vanquished.
Humbled, Democratic Union of Kobolalibela bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Bozedia, paying yearly tribute.
Fogu of Oyo-petege takes up the cause of the fortunes of the dynasty.
The reign of Shravvo the Fortunate Crihratvo in Oyo-petege concludes with their death (a hunting accident). Fogu takes up the royal mantle, vowing to defend the clan-state.
Qasñap II of Nirmarca turns from the old cause toward glory.
In Nirmarca, Qasñap the Grim Ruqñiw departs this life, succumbing to poison. The child Qasñap (age 9) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Fatabad are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Shrisva!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Wipbamba stir mutiny among garrison troops in Yokhtosh!
QUEST COMPLETED: Rebuilding the Ice-Torn Bridge of Tregorod! Nyha walks the first loaded wagon across, and the town awards Immortal Renown and a steadier realm!

The War of Lenmennesnel is known as the Reclamation among the Chanmat, and as the Usurpation among the Yaki.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Folzhekh give way! Vanguard forces of Bozedia storm the royal seat of Folzhekh, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
Neither camp can break the front: envoys sign a mutual cessation of hostilities, ending the War of the Kaksih Crown (3 years) in an uneasy truce.

Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Merchant League of Mabo launches a determined invasion into People's Republic of Goshokhzim, igniting the Great Mabo War. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Helukenese rally to Goshokhzim's side.
Mengeti II of Mefahuma takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
In Mefahuma, Mivsinga the Watchful Ngampit departs this life, succumbing to a wasting sickness. The child Mengeti (age 4) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.
Haso of Goga comes to the throne bent on the safety of the clan-state.
A perilous interregnum grips Goga following the heirless death of Firu (old age). Retainers of House Moso storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
Kitwomlis of Niwkenpin takes up the cause of wealth.
Mourning envelops Niwkenpin: Hasweha the Younger Moylepwek dies of a hunting accident. The royal scepter passes to Kitwomlis, an underage youth of 3 years, under the stewardship of high chancellors.
Wuhe (Grand Champion) sweeps all contenders in the Grand Tourney to ecstatic cheers from thousands in Patunui.

COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by One strike at midnight in Oyo-petege! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Polytechnic League of Oyo-petege!
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Brogva storm the government palace in Ngogha! The faction seizes control, establishing the Stratocracy of Ngogha.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Yadstan! Yullela seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Principality of Yadstan!

COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Shopali strike at midnight in Pishavdesh! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Artificer Directorate of Pishavdesh!
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Richola storm the government palace in Wechu! The faction seizes control, establishing the Protectorate of Wechu.
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Reno storm the government palace in Pawo! The faction seizes control, establishing the High Realm of Pawo.
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Tradesh are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Mabo!
QUEST COMPLETED: Delve into the Primeval Foundry in Tlehnet! Nu'bobu returns triumphant from Tlehnet, having uncovered forgotten secrets and winning Immortal Renown!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Bavnokbaka embarks upon the Search for the Lost Poet Cycle of Mowekagondar! Bavnokbaka follows a rumor that a famous cycle of poems was hidden in a tower library at Mowekagondar.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Pihsuyu pave the Nirmarca-Nirnuq Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Nirmarca and Nirnuq (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Pria pave the Ngyplu-Wegiwitu Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Ngyplu and Wegiwitu (+trade, +stability).
The biomass vats of Kingatuwa sour; hungry crowds tear open the grown-walls of Kingatuwa’s feeding halls.
Rogue splicer Masmat cures a blight in Ngumvum that the clans of Silrar engineered; the poor make them a saint.
The Seekers of the Primal Strain spreads a whispering fungus through Kaksih, promising one shared mind for all.

Kitwomlis of Niwkenpin fills the treasury, the wealth long sought.

The tiny Confederation of Ngapeta seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Ngahu.
A royal wedding joins Fome of Petenogogo and One of Oyo-petege; the two realms are united under one crown.

SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Silrar close the air-lanes above Lukavo, starving Miragu of the high trade.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.
